title: China Slams US Claims About Starbucks in Xinjiang as 'Lie'
detail: China's foreign ministry condemned US claims about Starbucks stores operating in Xinjiang as a 'lie', escalating diplomatic friction over the Xinjiang human rights narrative. The rebuke underscores ongoing tension between Beijing and Washington over Xinjiang-related allegations.

media.caption: China's foreign ministry denounces US claims about Starbucks operating in Xinjiang
